subject: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@stellarai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for your time today. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan template and a quick two‑slide checklist that we can use to run a focused 21‑day pilot. Both are editable (links below).

High level proposal (compressed 21‑day path):
- Week 0 (3 days): kickoff + integration checklist (API keys, sample dataset ingest)
- Week 1 (7 days): model evaluation + latency/cost baseline (we run perf tests against your workloads)
- Week 2 (7 days): quality tuning + acceptance tests (prompt set + rollout guardrails)
- Final 4 days: acceptance review, sign‑off, and short runbook for handoff

Key asks from your side:
1) Confirm primary stakeholders (tech, security, procurement)
2) Share any non‑negotiable acceptance criteria (SLOs, data residency)
3) Confirm 30‑minute slot for a MAP workshop (we recommend Dec 9 or Dec 10)

Links (editable):
- MAP template (GDoc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-MAP-Template-v1
- Quick deck (GSlides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xYz-QuickDeck-v1

Attachments: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc, MAP_QuickDeck_v1.gslides (live links above).

I've seeded the doc with a simple acceptance matrix and a short list of deliverables per sprint. Marissa, Jonas — tagging you for any immediate edit suggestions before I send to Elena's broader team.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
priyom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@stellarai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the fast turn. Quick notes after a skim:
- The plan looks good, but our ops team would prefer a shorter pilot if possible — could we compress to ~14 days? We still want all checkpoints, just tighter windows.
- We have a mandatory data residency requirement in EU for the sample dataset; can you flag the MAP where we specify region and any implications?
- I'm looping Samir (cc'ed) — he's owning the technical delivery on our side.

Available for the 30‑minute workshop on Dec 9 (afternoon PT). Please add Samir and any security folks you expect to attend.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rodriguez | Head of ML Ops
StellarAI
elena@stellarai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@stellarai.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides

Priyom — good draft. A few inline edits I pushed to the GDoc:
- Added an "Acceptance criteria matrix" section (row/column template) — saved as a PNG stub in attachments for quick view.
- Suggested shifting the perf baseline to day 2 of Week 1 so we can parallelize dataset ingest and basic smoke tests.
- Added a short note on fallbacks: if hosted capacity constrained, we propose auto‑fallback to a quantized variant (caller can opt out).

Attaching: Acceptance_Matrix_template.png (see GDoc for placement).

Jonas — tagging you for the cost/throughput bullets; can you confirm whether the perf run needs a dedicated GPU slot or we can run within hosted credits?

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@stellarai.com>, Samir Patel <samir@stellarai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the notes. We can do a compressed 14‑day pilot by tightening the acceptance windows and running perf + ingest in parallel (Marissa's suggestion). I've updated the MAP doc to include an explicit "Data residency" row and a short implications section (EU residency will need a private tenant option or EU region hosted deployment; we'll surface any additional latency/cost delta in the perf run).

Proposed workshop: Dec 9, 2026 at 2:30 PM PT — 30 minutes. Agenda: 1) confirm stakeholders/success criteria (10m), 2) map milestone owners & timeline (10m), 3) immediate blockers/next steps (10m).

Prep for the meeting: please review the MAP doc and add your top 3 acceptance metrics in the GDoc comments. I'll bring a one‑page runbook for onboarding.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@stellarai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@stellarai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook Draft: 21-day Pilot MAP & Quick Slides

Priyom —

Confirmed for Dec 9 at 2:30 PM PT. I've added our initial acceptance metrics to the doc (throughput targets + end‑to‑end P99 latency). Samir will upload a small sample dataset to the Drive folder you shared prior to the workshop.

One ask before we meet: can you add a short note on procurement steps (estimated timeline for PO + contract signature) to the MAP? Our procurement lead wants to see a simple 2‑line path.

See you Thursday.

—Elena
Elena Rodriguez | Head of ML Ops
StellarAI
